{{TagLine|5G NR Enhanced Gateway}} :{{ProductPage|http://us.dlink.com/products/service-provider-solutions/5gnr-enhanced-gateway/}} ===Links=== *[https://www.4gltemall.com/d-link-dwr-2010-5g-nr-router.html ''D-Link DWR-2010 5G NR Enhanced Router/Gateway'' on '''4G|LTEmall'''] ===Specifications=== * AC2600 Dual Band Wi-Fi (800+1733Mbps) with MU-MIMO : 802.11n 4x4 MIMO, 802.11ax 2x2 or 802.11ac 4x4 * Chipset: [[Qualcomm]] SDX55 ([https://www.qualcomm.com/products/snapdragon-x50-5g-modem X50 5G Modem]) * Embedded 5G NR NSA Module (3GPP Rel.15) : Sub-6GHz or mmWave frequency compatible : 200MHz (2x100MHz)/800MHz (8x100MHz) BW * Antenna: 4x external antennas for LTE/5G NR * Ports: USB: 1x USB 3.0 port; Ethernet: 5x ports: : 1x GbE WAN/LAN, 3x GbE LAN, 1x 2.5GbE LAN * Whole home coverage with Wi-Fi Mesh Network * Support [[ZigBee]]/Z-Wave/BT BLE features for [[IoT]] * Supports VoLTE, Remote Management (TR-069) and FOTA * World's first 5G NR Home Gateway; Auto Firmware Upgrade ===See also=== *[[D-Link DWR-2010]] (AC2600) - 5G NR Enhanced Gateway • [https://www.dlink-forum.it/index.php?topic=4266.0 5G CPE] *[[D-Link DWR-2101]] (AX1800) - 5G Mobile Hotspot Wi-Fi 6 • [https://www.dlink-forum.it/index.php?topic=4266.0 5G CPE] *[[Samsung SFG-D0100]] - 5G Home Router • [https://www.4gltemall.com/samsung-sfg-d0100-5g-home-router.html 5G CPE] *[[Netgear Nighthawk M1 (MR1100)]] - 4GX Gigabit LTE Mobile Router • [https://www.4gltemall.com/netgear-nighthawk-m1-mr1100.html 4G] *[[Netgear Nighthawk M2]] - 5G Mobile Router (X24 LTE Modem) • [https://www.4gltemall.com/netgear-nighthawk-m2.html 5G CPE] *[[Netgear Nighthawk M5 Fusion (MR5000)]] - 5G Mobile Hotspot • [https://www.4gltemall.com/netgear-nighthawk-m5-fusion.html 5G CPE] :[[Qualcomm]] SM8150/SDX50M (''SnapDragon X50'' 5G Modem) • [https://www.reddit.com/r/ATT/comments/aalipg/att_nighthawk_5g_mr5000/ Reddit] __NOTOC__
